question: Who founded Zenteiq.ai?
source_chunk:
Zenteiq.ai was founded in 2022 by Prof. Dr. Sashikumaar Ganesan, who is also the
Chief AI Officer (CAiO) and acting CEO/CTO. He is a professor at IISc Bangalore with
expertise in Scientific AI, computational fluid dynamics (CFD), high-performance
computing (HPC), machine learning, MLOps, and DevOps. Prof. Ganesan leads the
AiREX Lab at IISc, which focuses on AI solutions for science and engineering, and is
deeply involved in developing Zenteiq's Scientific Foundation Models (SFMs).
Currently, Zenteiq is focused on building large-scale Scientific Foundation Models (8
to 80 billion parameters) to accelerate research and development in aerospace,
defense, energy, and advanced manufacturing. They have been selected by the
Government of India under the IndiaAI Mission and received ₹75 crore funding to
develop India's sovereign foundational models that provide physics-consistent
engineering predictions. The company has roughly 11-50 employees and is scaling
up rapidly, with a focus on advanced AI platforms integrating physics, scientific
machine learning, and causal reasoning.

Chief AI Officer (CAiO) and acting CEO/CTO. He is a professor at IISc Bangalore with
expertise in Scientific AI, computational fluid dynamics (CFD), high-performance
computing (HPC), machine learning, MLOps, and DevOps. Prof. Ganesan leads the
AiREX Lab at IISc, which focuses on AI solutions for science and engineering, and is
deeply involved in developing Zenteiq's Scientific Foundation Models (SFMs).
Currently, Zenteiq is focused on building large-scale Scientific Foundation Models (8
to 80 billion parameters) to accelerate research and development in aerospace,
defense, energy, and advanced manufacturing. They have been selected by the
Government of India under the IndiaAI Mission and received ₹75 crore funding to
develop India's sovereign foundational models that provide physics-consistent
engineering predictions. The company has roughly 11-50 employees and is scaling
up rapidly, with a focus on advanced AI platforms integrating physics, scientific
machine learning, and causal reasoning.
